drafted_from: tool:keep-hearing-session row in tools/listen-for-a-while/what-this-tool-does-and-how-to-run-it.json and keepHearingSession in read-data/keep-hearing-session.mjs (the keep step of tool:hear-sources; the old automatic keeping, computer/hearing-sources.mjs:50-57 @b7dc53d08a)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Keep the session tool:hear-sources answered in my proofs database." It runs tool:keep-hearing-session with the session record and the database name.
no_lists_because: It names no list: it writes the session record it is given into the hearing_sessions table of the database named in its input, and nothing else.
instructions: 1. Run tool:hear-sources first and keep its `session` answer.

2. Say "Keep that session in <database>" and call do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run and tool tool:keep-hearing-session (session is required; database names the person's database).
3. Read the answer: kept_in is the table and kept is the number of records written.

worked_examples.title: A session record is kept in the person's database
worked_examples.ask: Keep the session the hearing answered in my proofs database.
worked_examples.given: The session record tool:hear-sources answered for two recordings (bd435513d5990856).
worked_examples.hands_back: The answer names kept_in hearing_sessions and kept 1; the record is one row in that table, its id bd435513d5990856. A session already kept under the same id is refused, and nothing is written.
